blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.
blocks.zh: 生物识别往往在部分面部相对于可视性下降解,其中传统的面部提示被所渗透. 前额区域始终可见并有明显的折痕,可作为生物特征的补充。 我们提出一个统一的eval - eu, 额头-craes识别 跨解释性的零射回声, 域-适应性学习, 和特异性的模型。 FIRE en能使用多式大语言模型解释可被零发校正,而经过预先训练的面相识别模型则通过边距学习来适应前头域. 在开放设定评价下,最佳零射出型GPT-4o+FIRE能达到18.22%的EER,而边缘-Forehead能达到8.3%的EER和54.01%的TDR@0.1%的FMR. 结果表明,虽然MLLMs提供可解释的零发-活性配子,但针对特征的学习对于强健的前额-折痕生物识别仍然更为有效.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Biometric verification systems [ 2 , 6 ] have achieved remarkable progress in recent years, largely driven by deep learning, supervised approaches. These methods leverage large-scale annotated datasets and powerful representation learning techniques [ 14 , 15 ] , enabling high recognition accuracy under controlled conditions. As a result, such systems are widely deployed in applications including access control, surveillance, and identity verification. However, their performance degrades significantly in unconstrained environments, particularly when faces are partially occluded due to masks, scarves, pose variations, or low-resolution imaging. In these scenarios, a substantial portion of the facial region becomes unavailable, limiting the effectiveness of holistic face-based representations.
To address this limitation, recent studies have explored partial facial regions and soft biometric traits that remain visible under occlusion [ 2 , 15 ] . Among these, the forehead is particularly promising due to its consistent visibility and rich structural characteristics.
Forehead creases provide discriminative identity cues, with prior studies demonstrating verification across images acquired in two sessions; however, their temporal stability remains insufficiently quantified [ 2 , 15 ] .
Furthermore, fine-grained skin texture and wrinkle patterns retain identity-discriminative information even in the absence of global facial cues.
blocks.zh:
生物计量核查制度[2,6]近年来取得了显著进展,主要受深入学习,监督的方法驱动. 这些方法利用了大型附加说明的数据集和强大的表示学习技术[14,15],使得在受控条件下的识别精度很高. 因此,这些系统广泛部署在各种应用程序中,包括出入控制、监视和身份核查。 然而,它们的性能在不受约束的环境下会显著地降解,特别是当面部被口罩,花纹所遮住,呈现出变化或低分辨率成像时. 在这些假想中,面部区域有很大一部分变得无法使用,限制了整体面相表达的有效性.
为了消除这一局限性,最近的研究探索了部分面部区域和软生物特征,这些特征在被隔离[2,15]下仍然可见. 其中前额由于其一贯的能见度和丰富的结构特征而特别有希望.
前额折叠提供了歧视性身份提示,以前的研究表明,在两会中获得的图像之间进行了核实;然而,其时间稳定性仍然不够量化[2、15]。
此外,即使没有全球面部提示,细纹皮肤纹理和皱纹图案也保留了身份歧视信息。

blocks.en:
Despite these advantages, existing forehead-crease recognition methods face several limitations. Most approaches rely on task specific architectures and do not fully exploit transferable representations learned by modern face recognition models. Although foundation models(FMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong Zero-Shot(ZS) capabilities, they are not optimized for subtle biometric cues such as crease topology, spacing, and texture continuity. In addition, prior studies often compare ZS and supervised approaches under different protocols, limiting fair evaluation. Finally, explainability in forehead-based biometric recognition remains largely underexplored despite its importance for transparency and real-world deployment.
In parallel, modern face recognition models
have been shown to learn hierarchical representations that capture not only global facial structure but also mid-level and fine-grained texture patterns [ 14 ] . This observation motivates an important research question: can pretrained face recognition models be effectively adapted to operate on spatially constrained regions such as the forehead? Recent advances in margin-based metric learning, including AdaFace [ 7 ] , CosFace [ 19 ] , and related formulations, provide a promising direction by enforcing strong intra-class compactness and inter-class separability, even under subtle appearance variations. These properties make them particularly suitable for modelling fine-scale biometric traits such as forehead creases. This work systematically compares FMs with domain-adaptive and trait-specific approaches for trustworthy and interpretable biometric verification.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些优势,但现有的额外识别方法面临若干限制. 多数做法依赖于特定任务结构,没有充分利用现代面相识别模式所学到的可转让表述。 虽然基础模型(FM)和多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)表现出了很强的"零"-Shot(ZS)能力,但是它们并没有被优化到细微的生物特征提示,如折叠地貌,间隔和纹理连续性等. 此外,先前的研究经常比较ZS和不同协议下的被监督的方法,限制了公平的评价. 最后,基于额头的生物鉴别识别的可解释性尽管对透明度和现实世界部署十分重要,但在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用。
同时,现代面相识别模型
不仅能捕捉全球面部结构, 也能捕捉中层和精细纹理图案。 这一观测激发了一个重要的研究问题:预先训练的面部识别模型能否被有效调整,在前额等空间受限区域运行? 基于差值的计量学习,包括AdaFace [7],CosFace [19],以及相关表述的近期进展,通过强制实行强烈的阶级内部紧凑性和阶级间可分性,甚至在微妙的外观变异下,提供了有希望的方向. 这些特性使得它们特别适合建模精细尺度的生物鉴别特征,如前额折痕. 这项工作系统地将调频与可信赖和可解释的生物鉴别核查领域适应性和特征性方法进行比较。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these insights, we propose a unified framework for explainable and domain-adaptive forehead-crease biometric recognition that integrates three complementary paradigms within a single system. Unlike prior work that treats these directions independently, our approach combines: (i) explainable zero-shot reasoning using multimodal models, (ii) domain adaptation of pretrained face recognition networks using margin-based metric learning, and (iii) a trait-specific model designed to explicitly capture fine-grained crease structures. This unified formulation enables a comprehensive understanding of the trade-off between interpretability, generalisation, and discriminative performance.
We evaluate the proposed framework under open-set verification protocols on real-world and synthetic forehead datasets. To ensure a fair and rigorous comparison, we benchmark multiple paradigms, including multimodal large language models, vision foundation models, domain-adapted face recognition systems, and specialised forehead-crease architectures. In addition, we conduct detailed ablation studies to analyse the impact of structured prompting, margin-based supervision, and training strategies on overall performance.
From an application perspective, the proposed system is particularly relevant in scenarios where full-face information is unavailable or unreliable, such as masked authentication, surveillance in unconstrained environments, and low-resolution or partial-face recognition. In such cases, forehead-crease biometrics can act as a complementary modality, improving robustness without requiring additional sensors or intrusive acquisition processes.
blocks.zh:
在这些见解的推动下,我们提出了一个统一的框架,用于对可解释和可域适应的前额-累加生物识别,将三个互补的范式纳入一个单一系统中。 与以前独立处理这些方向的工作不同,我们的方法结合了: (一)使用多模式解释性零镜头推理, (二)利用边距度量学对预先训练过的面部识别网络进行域位调整, (三)一个特异性模型,旨在明确捕捉精细的花纹结构. 这种统一的表述使得人们能够全面了解可解释性、通俗化和歧视性表现之间的取舍。
我们评价关于现实世界和合成额头数据集的开放式核查议定书下的拟议框架。 为了确保公平和严格的比较,我们将多种范式作为基准,包括多模式的大型语言模型、愿景基础模型、适合域名的面部识别系统以及专门的额外刻画结构。 此外,我们进行了详细的减税研究,以分析结构化催化、以差值为基础的监督和培训战略对总体业绩的影响。
从应用的角度来看,拟议的系统在缺乏完整面相信息或不可靠的情况下特别相关,例如蒙面认证、在不受限制的环境中进行监视以及低分辨率或部分面相识别。 在这种情况下,前额脉冲生物鉴别技术可以起到补充作用,提高稳健性,而不需要额外的传感器或侵入性获取程序。

blocks.en:
Contributions. The main contributions of this work are: (i) a unified framework integrating explainable zero-shot reasoning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling for forehead-crease recognition; (ii) adaptation of pretrained face-recognition models to forehead biometrics through margin-based metric learning; (iii) FIRE, a structured framework for interpretable multimodal verification; (iv) a balanced open-set evaluation of zero-shot, domain-adaptive, and trait-specific approaches; and (v) an assessment of forehead-crease biometrics for partial-face recognition scenarios.
The remainder of this paper is structured as follows. Section 2 reviews related work. Section 3 presents the proposed methodology. Section 4 describes the datasets and evaluation protocols. Section 5 presents the results and discussion, followed by additional ablation studies and prompt analyses are provided in the supplementary material. Finally, Section 6 concludes the paper.
blocks.zh:
捐款。 这项工作的主要贡献是:(一) 整合可解释的零射推理、域适应学习和特异性识别模型的统一框架;(二) 通过以边距为基础的计量学习,使预先训练过的面识别模型适应额定生物鉴别;(三) FIRE,可解释的多式核查结构框架;(四) 对零射、域适应和特异性特定方法的平衡开放评价;(五) 评估部分面识别情景的额定生物鉴别方法。
本文件其余部分的结构如下。 第2节审查有关工作。 第3节介绍了拟议方法。 第4节介绍了数据集和评价协议。 第5节介绍结果和讨论,然后在补充材料中进行补充研究并及时进行分析。 最后,文件第6节结束。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we review existing literature on forehead-based biometrics, face recognition and domain adaptation, and explainable verification using multimodal models. We also highlight key limitations and position our contribution within these research directions.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们审查关于额头生物鉴别的现有文献,面对识别和域调整,以及使用多模式进行解释性核查。 我们还强调我们在这些研究方向中的贡献的主要局限和定位。

blocks.en: 2.1 Forehead-Based Biometric Recognition
blocks.zh: 2.1 前头生物计量识别

blocks.en: Forehead-based biometrics has emerged as a promising complementary modality for identity verification, particularly in scenarios where the lower facial region is occluded. Early approaches relied on handcrafted features, such as texture descriptors and edge-based representations, to model wrinkle patterns and skin structure. While these methods demonstrated that forehead creases contain identity-discriminative information, they were limited in handling variations in illumination, facial expression, and image resolution.
blocks.zh: 基于前脑的生物鉴别技术已成为身份核查的一种有希望的补充方式,特别是在面部较低区域被占据的情况下。 早期的方法依赖于手制特征,如纹理描述符和以边缘为基点的表示,来建模皱纹图案和皮肤结构. 虽然这些方法表明前额折痕中含有身份歧视信息,但它们在处理发光、面部表情和图像分辨率变化方面受到限制。

blocks.en:
With the advancement of deep learning, recent works have shifted towards data-driven approaches for modelling forehead characteristics. Methods such as FHCVS [ 2 ] and FH-SSTNet [ 15 ] introduced specialised architectures designed to capture the spatial arrangement and structural properties of forehead creases. These models explicitly learn representations based on line patterns, curvature, and local texture variations, achieving improved performance over handcrafted pipelines. Similarly, convolutional neural network–based approaches trained directly on forehead regions have demonstrated the ability to extract discriminative features under controlled settings [ 2 , 15 ] .
To address the limited availability of annotated datasets, synthetic data generation has also been explored. Synthetic forehead datasets attempt to model variations in crease patterns, shape, and illumination, enabling controlled experimentation and data augmentation. However, models trained on synthetic data often suffer from domain shift when applied to real-world images, resulting in degraded performance.
blocks.zh:
随着深入学习的进步,近期的作品已转向以数据为动力的额头特征建模方法. FHCVS[2]和FH-SSTNet[15]等方法引入了专门架构,旨在捕捉前额折痕的空间安排和结构属性. 这些模型明确学习了基于行图,曲率,局部纹理变化的表达方式,实现了比手工管线更好的性能. 同样,直接在额头地区培训的以神经神经网络为基础的方法也证明,在受控环境中能够提取出歧视性特征[2,15]。
为了解决附加说明的数据集有限问题,还探讨了合成数据的生成。 合成额头数据集试图对折叠模式、形状和发光的变化进行模型化,从而能够进行有控制的实验并增加数据。 然而,在合成数据方面接受过培训的模型在应用到现实世界的图像时往往会出现域位变化,导致性能退化.

blocks.en: Despite these advancements, several limitations remain. Most existing approaches are highly task-specific and do not leverage transferable representations from large-scale face recognition models. In addition, evaluations are often conducted on relatively small datasets, limiting insights into generalisation. Furthermore, comparisons across methods are typically restricted, making it difficult to establish a comprehensive understanding of performance across different paradigms. These challenges motivate the need for a more unified and scalable approach that combines domain-specific modelling with transferable feature learning.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但仍有一些限制。 大多数现行做法都高度针对具体任务,没有利用大规模面相识别模式的可转让表述。 此外,评价往往以较小的数据集进行,限制了对一般化的洞察力。 此外,不同方法之间的比较通常受到限制,因此难以全面了解不同范式的业绩。 这些挑战促使需要一种更加统一和可扩展的方法,将特定领域的建模与可转移特征学习结合起来。

blocks.en: 2.2 Face Recognition and Domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 脸部识别和领域适应

blocks.en:
Face recognition has achieved significant success through deep metric learning frameworks trained on large-scale datasets [ 14 ] . Models such as FaceNet learn embedding spaces where identity-related features are well separated, enabling robust verification across varying conditions. A key strength of these models lies in their ability to learn hierarchical representations that capture both global facial structure and fine-grained texture information.
This property suggests that pretrained face recognition models may be transferable to localised regions such as the forehead. Recent studies have explored domain adaptation strategies, including fine-tuning pretrained networks and employing margin-based loss functions such as AdaFace [ 7 ] and CosFace [ 19 ] . These approaches improve feature discrimination by enforcing intra-class compactness and inter-class separability, particularly under subtle appearance variations.
However, forehead-crease biometrics remain largely underexplored. Existing methods rarely investigate the transferability of pretrained face-recognition representations to this fine-grained and spatially constrained trait, leaving the effectiveness of domain adaptation for forehead-crease verification an open question.
blocks.zh:
通过对大型数据集进行培训的深入的衡量学习框架,脸部识别取得了显著成功。 FaceNet等模型学习与身份相关特征紧密分离的嵌入空间,从而能够在不同条件下进行有力的核查。 这些模型的一个关键优势在于它们能够学习分级表现,既能捕捉到全球面部结构,又能捕捉到精细纹理信息.
这种地产表明,经过预先训练的面相识别模型可以被转让给前额等局部地区. 最近的研究探讨了域内适应战略,包括微调预先培训的网络,并采用基于差值的损失功能,如AdaFace [7]和CosFace [19]. 这些方法通过强化阶级内部的紧凑性和阶级之间的分离性,特别是在微妙的外观差异下,改进了歧视的特点。
然而,前额骨折生物鉴别技术仍然基本上没有得到充分利用。 现有方法很少调查预先训练过的面部识别表示是否可转让给这种精细和空间受限的特征,使前额-外额核查域的适应效果成为一个未决问题。

blocks.en: 2.3 Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 多式联运大语文模式

blocks.en:
Recent advances in multimodal learning have led to the development of powerful vision-language models that jointly process visual and textual information. These models combine visual encoders with large language models, enabling them to interpret images and generate descriptive or reasoning-based outputs. They have demonstrated strong performance across tasks such as visual question answering, image captioning, and visual reasoning.
A key advantage of these models is their ability to perform zero-shot inference, allowing them to generalise to new tasks without task-specific training. This makes them particularly appealing for biometric applications where labelled data is limited, such as forehead-crease recognition. Moreover, multimodal models offer a unique advantage in terms of explainability. Unlike traditional biometric systems that provide only similarity scores, these models can generate human-interpretable justifications based on visual evidence, enhancing transparency and trust.
Despite these benefits, multimodal models face several limitations in fine-grained biometric tasks. Forehead-crease recognition requires precise analysis of subtle texture patterns and structural variations, which general-purpose models are not explicitly designed to capture. Their performance is sensitive to variations in illumination, resolution, and expression, and they may produce inconsistent predictions or hallucinated reasoning when differences between samples are subtle.
FMs and MLLMs are pretrained on large-scale multimodal corpora and exhibit strong zero-shot and few-shot generalization capabilities. These properties make them attractive for biometric applications, where acquiring large annotated datasets is often difficult. Unlike conventional biometric systems that require task-specific training, MLLMs can perform verification through prompt-driven reasoning and provide human-interpretable explanations.
However, biometric recognition operates under stringent security constraints, requiring extremely low EER and high TMR at low FMR operating points. Generic foundation models are optimized for broad visual-semantic understanding rather than fine-grained biometric discrimination. Furthermore, large-scale deployment introduces practical challenges related to computational cost, inference latency, and scalability. These limitations motivate a systematic comparison between generic foundation models, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific biometric models.
blocks.zh:
最近在多模式学习方面取得的进展已导致形成了强大的视觉语言模式,共同处理视觉和文字信息。 这些模型结合了视觉编码器和大型语言模型,使其能够解释图像并生成描述性或以推理为基础的输出. 他们展现出在视觉问答、图像字幕和视觉推理等任务方面的有力表现。
这些模型的一个关键优势是它们能够进行零发推论,使得它们能够在没有特定任务培训的情况下对新任务进行概括. 这使得它们在贴有标签的数据有限的情况下特别吸引生物鉴别技术的应用,例如额外-额外识别。 此外,多式联运模式在可解释性方面提供了独特的优势。 与仅提供相似性分数的传统生物鉴别系统不同,这些模型可以产生基于视觉证据的可人解释的理由,增强透明度和信任.
尽管有这些好处,但多式联运模式在精细的生物鉴别任务方面面临若干限制。 前额-后额识别需要对微妙的纹理形态和结构变化进行精确分析,而通用模型没有明确用于捕捉. 它们的性能对发光,分辨率,和表达方式的变化很敏感,当样品之间的差别微妙时,它们可能会产生不一致的预测或幻觉推理.
调频和MLLMs在大型多模式阵型上预训,并表现出强大的零发和少发通缩能力. 这些特性使它们对生物鉴别技术的应用具有吸引力,因为在那里往往很难获得大型附加说明的数据集。 与需要特定任务培训的常规生物鉴别系统不同,MLLM能够通过即时驱动的推理进行验证,并提供人可解释的解释.
然而,生物鉴别识别在严格的安全限制下运作,在低的FMR操作点需要极低的EER和高的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国。 通用的基础模型得到优化,以便进行广义的视觉语义理解,而不是细微的生物鉴别歧视。 此外,大规模部署在计算费用、推断延迟性和可扩展性方面提出了实际挑战。 这些限制促使对通用基础模型、域适应学习和特异性生物鉴别模型进行系统比较。

blocks.en: 2.4 Limitations of Existing Work
blocks.zh: 2.4 现有工作的限制

blocks.en:
Despite recent progress, forehead-crease biometrics remain underexplored, with limited use of pretrained face-recognition models, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and insufficient study of explainability and domain shift.
To address these gaps, we systematically evaluate foundation, domain-adaptive face-recognition, and trait-specific models under a unified protocol, comparing their interpretability, transferability, and verification performance.
blocks.zh:
尽管最近取得了进展,但额外脉冲生物鉴别技术仍然没有得到充分利用,对预先训练过的面部识别模型的使用有限,评价协议不一致,对可解释性和域位变化的研究不足。
为了弥补这些差距,我们系统地评估一个统一协议下的基础、适合域的面部识别和特性模式,比较其可解释性、可转让性和核查性能。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en:
In this section, we present the proposed unified framework for forehead-crease–based biometric recognition. The goal is to design a reliable verification system that operates solely on the forehead region, particularly in scenarios where full-face information is unavailable due to occlusion or masking.
Unlike conventional approaches that rely on a single paradigm, our framework integrates three complementary components: (i) an explainable Zero-Shot verification module using multimodal reasoning, (ii) a Domain-adaptive learning module that transfers knowledge from pretrained face recognition models, and (iii) a Trait-Specific model designed to capture fine-grained crease structures.
The overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
在这一节中,我们提出了基于前额-增量-生物鉴别识别的拟议统一框架。 目的是设计一种可靠的核查制度,它完全在额头地区运作,特别是在由于被遮住或蒙住面而无法获得完整信息的情况下。
与依赖单一范式的常规方法不同的是,我们的框架融合了三个互补的组成部分:(一) 使用多模式推理的可解释性零热验证模块;(二) 从预先训练的面部识别模型中转移知识的域-适应性学习模块;以及(三) 为捕捉细纹折痕结构而设计的Trait-Specificial模型.
整个管道如图1所示。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en:
Given a pair of forehead images ( 𝐱 i , 𝐱 j ) (\mathbf{x}_{i},\mathbf{x}_{j}) , the objective is to determine whether they belong to the same identity. This is formulated as a binary verification task: y i ​ j = { 1 , if ​ 𝐱 i ​ and ​ 𝐱 j ​ belong to the same subject , 0 , otherwise . y_{ij}=\begin{cases}1,&\text{if }\mathbf{x}_{i}\text{ and }\mathbf{x}_{j}\text{ belong to the same subject},\\
0,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases} (1)
blocks.zh:
给一对前额图像(x i, x j) (\ mathb{x}_{i},\mathb{x}_{j}),目的是确定它们是否属于同一身份. 这是作为二进制验证任务制定的: y i j = { 1, 如果 x i 和 x j 属于同一主体, 0, 否则. y_{ij}=\begin{ cases}1,&\text{if}\mathbf{x}_{i}\text{和}\mathbf{x}_{j}\text{属于同一主题},\\\
0, \\ text{ 其它情况下}.\ end{ cases} (1) 国家

blocks.en: The system produces a similarity score s i ​ j ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{ij}\in[0,1] . For explainable models, it additionally outputs a structured textual explanation describing the reasoning behind the decision.
blocks.zh: 系统产生相近的分数 s i j ∈ [0, 1] s i j }\in [0, 1]. 对于可解释的模型,它还提出了结构化的文字解释,说明决定背后的理由。

blocks.en: 3.2 Forehead Region Extraction and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.2 前区采掘和预处理

blocks.en: Face images are first processed to extract the forehead region using a fixed cropping strategy, ensuring spatial consistency across samples. As forehead creases are predominantly structural and textural cues, the cropped regions are converted to grayscale to reduce appearance variability. The resulting images are replicated across three channels and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 for compatibility with standard CNN architectures. During training, horizontal flipping, small rotations, and brightness perturbations are applied to improve generalization while preserving discriminative crease patterns.
blocks.zh: 面相图像首先采用固定收割策略来取出额相区域,确保各样本的空间一致性. 由于前额折叠主要是结构与纹理提示,被收割的区域被转换为灰色尺度来降低外观可变性. 由此产生的图像通过三个频道复制,并被调整为224×224 2.24\times 224,与标准的CNN架构相容. 在训练期间,横向翻转,小旋转,亮度扰动被应用来改进通俗化,同时保留有歧义的花纹模式.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Forehead-crease verification pipeline using real and synthetic image pairs evaluated with MLLMs, FMs and trait-specific models.
blocks.zh: 图 1:使用真实和合成的图像配对,用MLLMs,调频和特异性特异性模型评价的前排-后排核查管道.

blocks.en: 3.3 Explainable Zero-Shot Verification via FIRE
blocks.zh: 3.3 通过FIRE进行解释性零热核查

blocks.en:
To enable interpretable biometric verification, we introduce the Forehead Interpretation and Reasoning Engine (FIRE (detailed prompt in supplementary material), a structured prompting framework that guides multimodal large language models (MLLMs) such as Claude [ 1 ] , GPT-4o [ 10 ] , and Gemini [ 18 ] .
Unlike supervised models, these systems are not explicitly trained for biometric verification. Therefore, we formulate the task as a structured reasoning problem using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting.
Each input consists of a pair of forehead images along with a carefully designed prompt that encourages step-by-step comparison.
The FIRE framework decomposes the verification process into multiple stages, including: (i) assessment of image conditions (lighting, occlusion, resolution), (ii) extraction of structural features (crease patterns, spacing, orientation), (iii) comparison of primary and secondary features, (iv) decision-making with confidence and dissimilarity estimation.
This structured reasoning reduces hallucinations and improves consistency compared to generic prompts. The model outputs both a classification (match/non-match) and a human-readable explanation, enabling transparent and interpretable verification. The complete FIRE (detailed prompt provided in the supplementary).
blocks.zh:
为了能够进行可解释的生物鉴别核查,我们采用了 " 前行解释和理性引擎 " (FIRE)(在补充材料中详细列出),这是一个结构化的提示框架,指导多式大型语言模型,如克洛德[1]、GPT-4o [10]和双子座[18]。
与受监督的模型不同,这些系统没有明确接受生物鉴别核查培训。 因此,我们利用 " 思考链 " 的提示,将这项任务确定为一个结构化的推理问题。
每个输入都由一对额头图像以及精心设计的鼓励分步比较的提示组成.
FIRE框架将核查过程分解为多个阶段,包括:(一) 图像条件评估(照明、隔离、分辨率);(二) 结构特征的取出(频率模式、间隔、取向);(三) 初级和二级特征的比较;(四) 有信心和不一致估计的决策。
这种有条理的推理比一般的提示减少了幻觉,提高了一致性. 该模型既提供分类(匹配/非匹配),又提供人能读取的解释,从而能够进行透明和可解释的核查。 完整的FIRE(补充资料中提供了详细提示)。

blocks.en: 3.4 Zero-Shot Verification using Vision Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 3.4 利用愿景基础模型进行零热核查

blocks.en:
To further analyse zero-shot generalisation, we evaluate vision foundation models (VFMs), including DINOv2 [ 11 ] and CLIP [ 13 ] , without task-specific fine-tuning.
Given an input forehead image 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} , an embedding 𝐳 i \mathbf{z}_{i} is extracted using a pretrained model. Verification is performed using cosine similarity: s i ​ j = 𝐳 i ⋅ 𝐳 j ‖ 𝐳 i ‖ ​ ‖ 𝐳 j ‖ s_{ij}=\frac{\mathbf{z}_{i}\cdot\mathbf{z}_{j}}{\|\mathbf{z}_{i}\|\|\mathbf{z}_{j}\|} (2) DINOv2 captures fine-grained structural features due to self-supervised training, while CLIP benefits from semantic alignment learned from image-text pairs. These models serve as strong zero-shot baselines for evaluating generalisation beyond traditional face recognition cues.
However, since these models are not trained specifically for forehead biometrics, their performance is sensitive to variations in illumination, expression, and domain shift, motivating the need for domain adaptation.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步分析"零射通",我们评价了视觉基础模型(VFMs),包括DINOv2 [11]和CLIP [13],没有针对特定任务的微调.
在输入前额图像 x i\ mathbf{x}_{i} 的情况下, 使用预先训练的模型提取出嵌入式 z i\ mathb{z}_{i} 。 使用同位素相似性进行校验:s i j = z i ⋅ z z z z z s_{ij}=\ frac{\mathbf{z}_{i}\i}\cdot\mathbf{z}_{j}}{\|\i}\|\|\mathb{z}_{i}\|\|\h{j}\|}j}\|}i}\|\|\i}\|\|\. (2)DINOv2由于自我监督的训练,捕捉出精细的纹理结构特征,而CLIP则得益于从图像-文本对子中学习到的语义对接. 这些模型是用于评估超出传统面相识别提示的通用性的强有力的零镜头基线。
然而,由于这些模型没有专门为前额生物鉴别学进行训练,因此其性能对发光、表达和域位变化的变化十分敏感,促使需要域位调整。

blocks.en: 3.5 Domain-Adaptive Learning using Pretrained Models
blocks.zh: 3.5 使用预先训练模型进行领域辅助学习

blocks.en: To address the limitations of zero-shot models, we adopt a domain-adaptive learning strategy that transfers knowledge from pretrained face recognition models to the forehead domain.
blocks.zh: 为了解决零镜头模型的局限性,我们采用了一个域-适应性学习策略,将知识从预先训练的面部识别模型转移到前额域.

blocks.en: Feature Representation
blocks.zh: 特性代表

blocks.en: Let f ⁡ ( ⋅ ) f(\cdot) denote a pretrained face recognition network. For an input image 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} , the model produces an embedding: 𝐳 i = f ⁡ ( 𝐱 i ) , 𝐳 i ∈ ℝ 512 \mathbf{z}_{i}=f(\mathbf{x}_{i}),\quad\mathbf{z}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{512} These embeddings capture identity-related information, which is further refined for forehead-specific features through fine-tuning. We employ multiple backbone architectures, including MobileFaceNet-V2 [ 4 ] , EdgeFace-Xs [ 5 ] , SwinFace [ 12 ] , and FaceNet [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 让 f \ (\ ) f (\ cdot) 表示一个预先训练过的面部识别网络 。 对于输入图像 xi\ mathbf{x}_{i} , 模型生成嵌入: z i = f ⁡ (x i), z i\ R 512\ mathbf{z}_{i}=f (\ mathb{x}_{i}),\quad\ mathb{z}_{i}\in\ mathbb{R}^{512} 这些嵌入物能捕捉出身份相关信息,通过微调对前额特有特征进行进一步完善. 我们使用多个骨干架构,包括MobileFaceNet-V2 [4],EdgeFace-Xs [5],SwinFace [12],和FaceNet [14].

blocks.en: Margin-Based Metric Learning
blocks.zh: 基于边际的计量学习

blocks.en: To enhance discriminability, we employ margin-based loss functions that enforce compact intra-class distributions and well-separated inter-class boundaries.
blocks.zh: 为加强差别性,我们采用以差值为基础的损失功能,强制实行紧凑的班级内部分配和分明的班级间界限。

blocks.en: We further evaluate several margin-based objectives, including ElasticFace (stochastic margin regularization) [ 3 ] , AdaFace [ 7 ] (quality-adaptive margin), MagFace [ 9 ] (magnitude-aware representation learning) , and CosFace [ 19 ] (additive cosine margin) . These objectives enhance intra-class compactness and inter-class separability, enabling more discriminative modeling of fine-grained forehead-crease patterns for robust verification.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价若干基于差值的目标,包括弹性差值规范化。 [3], AdaFace [7] (质量适应比值), MagFace [9] (放大-意识表现学习), CosFace [19] (附加同位素比值). 这些目标加强了阶级内部的紧凑性和阶级之间的分化,使得能对精细的额冠模式采取更歧视性的模式,以便进行有力的核查。

blocks.en: Forehead Interpretation and Reasoning Engine (FIRE) Input: Two forehead images. Output: Match/Non-Match, Confidence Score, Dissimilarity Score, and Explanation. Step 1: Assess image quality (lighting, occlusion, resolution, expression). Step 2: Extract and compare forehead-crease characteristics, including topology, spacing, orientation, continuity, forehead shape, and permanent marks. Step 3: Normalize illumination, scale, occlusion, and expression variations. Step 4: Evaluate feature consistency, assign confidence weights, and estimate similarity. Step 5: Generate the final decision with confidence, dissimilarity score, and reasoning. Constraint: Use only observable forehead features and explicitly report uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 前额解释和理性引擎(FIRE) 输入:两个额头图像. 产出:匹配/非匹配、信任分、分歧分和解释。 第1步:评估图像质量(照明、隔离、分辨率、表达)。 步骤 2: 取出并比较额外折痕特征,包括地貌,相距,取向,连续性,额外形状,和永久标记等. 第3步:使照明、尺度、隔离和表达变化正常化。 第4步:评价特征一致性,分配信任权重并估计相似性。 第5步:以自信,分数不一,推理的方式产生最终决定. 约束:仅使用可观察到的前额特征,并在证据不足时明确报告不确定性。

blocks.en: 3.6 Trait-Specific Model: Edge-Forehead
blocks.zh: 3.6 有轨电车的具体型号: 边前头

blocks.en:
While domain-adaptive models improve performance, they are still derived from general face representations. To further enhance fine-grained discrimination, we introduce a trait-specific model, Edge-Forehead , tailored for forehead-crease recognition.
We fine-tune the EdgeFace model [ 5 ] on forehead images using a gradual unfreezing strategy, allowing the network to retain general facial features while progressively specialising in crease-specific patterns.
To improve embedding quality, we employ a dual-loss objective: ℒ total = α ​ ℒ ce + β ​ ℒ center \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}=\alpha\mathcal{L}_{\text{ce}}+\beta\mathcal{L}_{\text{center}} (3)
blocks.zh:
虽然域适应模型能改善性能,但它们仍然取自于一般的面相表示. 为了进一步加强精细歧视,我们采用了一种特异性模式,即Edge-Forehead。
我们用逐渐解冻的策略来微调额头图像上的EdgeFace模型[5],使网络能够保留一般面部特征,同时逐渐在折痕特异性图案中进行特异性.
为了提高嵌入质量,我们采用双重损失目标: L 总计 = α L ce + β L 中心 \ mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}=\pha\mathcal{L}_{\text{ce}}+\beta\mathcal{L}_{\text{中正} (三)

blocks.en:
where ℒ ce \mathcal{L}_{\text{ce}} enforces inter-class separability and ℒ center \mathcal{L}_{\text{center}} reduces intra-class variance. The weighting parameters α \alpha and β \beta balance classification accuracy and feature compactness.
By focusing exclusively on forehead regions, the model(Figure 1 , Part E) learns fine-grained structural characteristics such as crease continuity, spacing, curvature, and texture patterns. This leads to improved robustness under variations in illumination, pose, and expression.
Finally, all models are evaluated under a unified verification protocol, enabling a fair comparison between zero-shot, domain-adaptive, and trait-specific approaches.
blocks.zh:
其中 Lce\ mathcal{L}_{\text{ce} 执行类间可分性和 L Centre\ mathcal{L}_{\text{center} 减少类内差异 。 加权参数α-α和β-β的平衡分类精度和特征紧凑.
该模型(图1,E部分)完全侧重于额头区域,从而学习了折叠连续性、相距、曲率和纹理等精细结构特征。 这导致在照明、姿势和表达方式的变化下增强稳健性。
最后,所有模型都根据统一的核查协议进行评估,以便能够公平比较零射法、域适应法和特异性方法。

blocks.en: 4 Dataset & Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4 数据集和评估协议

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the datasets and evaluation protocol used to assess the proposed framework across zero-shot, domain-adaptive, and trait-specific models. Forehead crease patterns are considered as the primary biometric trait. Experiments are conducted on both real and synthetic datasets to ensure comprehensive evaluation under diverse conditions. We design a unified protocol to enable fair comparison across MLLMs, VFMs, and supervised forehead-crease recognition systems.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了用于评估拟议框架的数据集和评价协议,这些数据集和评价协议跨越了零镜头、适合域和特性的特定模型。 前脑折痕模式被认为是主要的生物特征。 对真实和合成数据集进行实验,以确保在各种条件下进行全面评估。 我们设计了一个统一的协议,以便能够在MLLM、VFM和受监督的前额识别系统中进行公平比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets for Zero-Shot Evaluation (LLMs & VFMs)
blocks.zh: 4.1 零热评价数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate zero-shot verification on two benchmark datasets subsets: a real dataset (FH-V2) and a synthetic dataset [ 16 ] . The synthetic dataset was obtained from [ 16 ] and used to evaluate forehead verification under synthetic image conditions. Masked face images are first processed to extract the forehead region, as shown in Figure 1 . To construct a reliable benchmark, a pretrained SOTA verification model [ 16 ] is used to compute similarity scores and select representative genuine and impostor pairs. Specifically, 50 genuine pairs from 50 unique subjects and 450 impostor pairs from 250 distinct subjects are sampled from both datasets. This high negative-to-positive ratio follows standard biometric evaluation protocols, ensuring robust score separation and stable performance estimation. The selected pairs capture variations in illumination, expression, and image quality, enabling a realistic assessment of MLLMs and VFMs for forehead-crease-based verification.
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个基准数据集子集的零发核查:一个真实数据集(FH-V2)和一个合成数据集[16]. 合成数据集取自[16]并用于在合成图像条件下评价额头验证. 如图1所示,被蒙面图像首先被处理取出前额区域。 为了构建一个可靠的基准,使用了经过预先训练的SOTA验证模型[16]来计算相似性分数并选择有代表性的真假相对. 具体来说,从两个数据集抽取了50个独特主体的50个真对和250个不同主体的450个假对. 这种高负对正比率遵循标准的生物鉴别评价规程,确保了稳健的分数分离和稳定的性能估计. 所选的对子捕捉出照明、表达和图像质量的变化,从而能够对MLLM和VFM进行现实的评估,以便进行以额头-重力为基础的核查。

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets for Domain-Adaptive & Trait-Specific Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 域与轨迹特定模型数据集

blocks.en: For supervised training, we use the FH-V1 dataset [ 2 ] , obtained by extracting forehead regions from face images using a fixed YOLOv6 [ 8 ] based cropping strategy. The dataset comprises 247 subjects with 2,462 gallery images and 2,502 probe images, totaling 4,964 images and variations in illumination, pose, expression, and image quality. Subjects are treated as unique identity classes, and a subject-disjoint train-validation split is employed to prevent identity leakage and support model selection. For open-set evaluation, all models are tested on FH-V2 [ 16 ] , comprising 295 unseen subjects and 29,500 genuine and approximately 8.67 million impostor verification pairs.

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Protocols
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训议定书

blocks.en:
Domain-adaptive and trait-specific models are trained on FH-V1 using a stratified 90%/10% train-validation split. Pretrained face-recognition backbones are fine-tuned using margin-based objectives (CosFace, AdaFace, MagFace, and ElasticFace). Edge-Forehead is initialized with EdgeFace-Base weights and trained in three stages: (i) cross-entropy with label smoothing ( ϵ = 0.1 \epsilon=0.1 ) and progressive unfreezing (70%, → \rightarrow ,0%), (ii) joint cross-entropy and center loss ( λ c ​ e ​ n ​ t ​ e ​ r = 0.3 \lambda_{center}=0.3 , α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 ) with augmentation (flip, ± 9 ∘ \pm 9^{\circ} rotation, 0.8–1.2 × \times scaling, grayscale), and (iii) semi-hard triplet mining with a dynamic margin (0.4–1.5). Stages 1–2 use SGD (lr= 10 − 3 10^{-3} , momentum=0.9, weight decay= 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , batch size=32), while Stage 3 uses Adam (lr= 10 − 5 10^{-5} , batch size=2). Early stopping (patience=3) is applied throughout training.
Images are resized to 112 × 112 112\times 112 . Verification uses Euclidean distance between 512-D embeddings, with thresholds set at EER. We use EdgeFace-Base (18.23M parameters) with dropout ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ) and a 247-class FC head. Training uses three stages: progressive unfreezing (70%, 50%, 30%, 10%, and 0% frozen; up to 15 epochs per setting), Stage 2 (up to 30 epochs), and Stage 3 (until convergence). The center-update rate and center-loss weight are α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 and β = 0.3 \beta=0.3 , respectively.

图像调整为112×112112\时 112. 核查使用512-D嵌入物之间的欧几利得相距,阈值为EER. 我们使用 EdgeFace-Base (18.23M参数) 并有被淘汰(p = 0.5 p = 0.5)和247级FC头. 培训采用三个阶段:逐步解冻(70%、50%、30%、10%和0%被冻结;每次设置不超过15个时段)、第二阶段(最多30个时段)和第三阶段(直至汇合)。 中心更新率和中心损耗重量分别为α=0.5\α=0.5和β=0.3\β=0.3.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价议定书

blocks.en:
To comprehensively evaluate the proposed framework, we consider three categories of models: (i) Multimodal LLMs: GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. (ii) Vision foundation models: DINOv2 and CLIP (iii) Supervised models: Edge-Forehead (proposed), and FHCVS.
All models are evaluated under a unified open-set verification protocol on both real (FH-V2) and synthetic datasets.
For zero-shot models (MLLMs and VFMs), each image pair undergoes three independent stateless inference runs to reduce output stochasticity. Final decisions are obtained via majority voting, with similarity/confidence scores averaged across runs. When refusals or conflicting predictions occur, the highest-confidence prediction is retained.
For domain-adaptive and trait-specific models, verification is performed using cosine similarity in the learned embedding space. Scores are computed and aggregated uniformly across models to ensure fair comparison. Performance is evaluated using standard biometric metrics, including Equal Error Rate (EER) and True Match Rate (TMR) at fixed False Match Rate (FMR) operating points of 0.1 and 0.01. These metrics provide a consistent framework for comparing zero-shot, domain-adaptive, and trait-specific approaches under varying operating conditions.
blocks.zh:
为全面评估拟议框架,我们考虑三类模式:(一) 多式联运有限责任公司:GPT-4o、克洛德·索内特4和双子座2.5 Pro. (二) 远景基础模型:DINOv2和CLIP(三) 监督模型:边前头(拟议)和FHCVS。
所有模型都根据关于真(FH-V2)和合成数据集的统一开放设置核查协议进行评估。
对于零发模型(MLLMs和VFMs),每个图像配对都经过了三个独立的无国籍推断跑来降低输出的分色. 最终决定是通过多数表决作出的,其相似性/信心分数平均跨行。 当出现拒绝或相矛盾的预测时,会保留最自信的预测.
对于域适应和特异性特异性模型,使用所学嵌入空间的同位素相似性进行校验. 各模型的分数均统一计算和汇总,以确保公平比较。 使用标准的生物测定指标来评价性能,包括0.1和0.01的固定假匹配率操作点的等误率和真匹配率。 这些指标为在不同的操作条件下比较零射法、域适应法和特异性方法提供了一个一致的框架。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Details: We use a subject-disjoint 90%/10% train validation split(seed=42). Verification pairs follow Section 4.1. Images are resized to 112 × 112 112\times 112 , normalized, and augmented. Edge-Forehead is initialized from pretrained EdgeFace-Base and trained using the three-stage schedule in Section 4.3. FIRE prompts, model versions, and three-run stateless inference settings are fixed. Verification thresholds are selected at EER using Euclidean distances between 512-D embeddings. It has approximately 18.23M parameters and requires 1,398.83 MFLOPs per forward pass.
blocks.zh: 可复制性 细节 : 我们使用一个主题不关联90%/10%的列车验证分拆(种子=42). 核查对数与第4.1节相接。 图像被调整为112×112 112\times 112,实现正版化,并增强. Edge-Forehead从经过预训的Edge-Face-Base上初始化,并使用4.3节中的三阶段时间表进行训练. FIRE 提示,模型版本,以及三运行的无国籍推论设置是固定的. 核查阈值是在EER中选择的,使用512-D嵌入物之间的欧几利得距离. 它有大约18.23M参数,每前行通道需要1,398.83MFLOP.

blocks.en: 5 Results & Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 成果和讨论

blocks.en: This section evaluates whether generic foundation models (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro , Claude Sonnet 4) can provide competitive verification performance to domain-adaptive and trait-specific biometric systems. While foundation models offer zero-shot generalization and explainability, biometric verification demands highly discriminative representations and strict operating characteristics. The experiments analyse this trade-off across all three paradigms under a unified protocol.
blocks.zh: 本节评价通用基础模型(GPT-4o,双子座2.5 Pro,克洛德·索内特 4)是否能够为适合域和特性的生物鉴别系统提供竞争性验证性能. 虽然基础模型提供零射通缩和可解释性,但生物鉴别核查需要高度歧视性的表述和严格的操作特征. 实验根据一个统一的协议,分析这三种范式的权衡.

blocks.en: 5.1 FIRE-based LLM and VFM Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 基于FIRE的LLM和VFM结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate the performance of FIRE-based multimodal LLMs and vision FMs on both real and synthetic datasets for zero-shot verification. The quantitative results are summarised in Table 1 and explainability examples in supplementary material Figure 3.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评价基于FIRE的多式LLMs和远景调频在真实和合成数据集上的性能,以便零发核查. 表1概述了定量结果,补充材料中说明了可解释性的例子。

blocks.en: Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 1: Identity verification results on the sampled FH-V2 verification subset (50 genuine and 450 impostor pairs) and synthetic subset. [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 表1:取样的FH-V2核查子集(50个真对和450个假对)和合成子集的身份核查结果。 [16].

blocks.en:
For reference, the trait-specific Edge-Forehead model achieves the best performance on the sampled FH-V2 evaluation subset (EER = 8.63%), while its full open-set evaluation on FH-V2 is reported separately in Section 5.2.
Results on the complete FH-V2 open-set evaluation are reported separately in Table 3 , where Edge-Forehead attains an EER of 8.30% with a True Match Rate (TMR) of 70.00% at both operating points. This represents a significant improvement over existing supervised approaches such as FHCVS (EER: 21.56%) and FH-SSTNet (EER: 14.22%).
Among zero-shot methods, GPT-4o achieves the strongest performance (EER: 18.22%, TMR: 52.00%), indicating that structured reasoning enables effective capture of identity-related cues even without task-specific training. DINOv2 also demonstrates competitive performance (TMR: 40.00%, 38.00%), suggesting that self-supervised representations retain sensitivity to fine-grained structural patterns. In contrast, CLIP exhibits relatively weaker performance, likely due to its emphasis on semantic alignment rather than fine texture discrimination.
On synthetic data, most zero-shot models degrade under domain shift, whereas Edge-Forehead maintains strong performance (EER: 0.25%; TMR: 94.00%). GPT-4o performs best among zero-shot models (EER: 25.44%) but struggles with synthetic variations. Overall, trait-specific learning improves verification accuracy and robustness, while zero-shot models offer interpretability.
blocks.zh:
供参考的是,特异性特异性边缘-Forehead模型在被抽样的FH-V2评价子集(EER=8.63%)上取得了最佳的性能,而其FH-V2上的全面开放设置评价则在第5.2节中单独报告.
完整的FH-V2开放式评价的结果在表3中另行报告,边缘-前头在两个操作点都达到8.3%的ER,真实匹配率为70.0%。 这比现有的监督方法,如FHCVS(EER:21.56%)和FH-SSTNet(EER:14.22%)大有改进。
在零射出的方法中,GPT-4o实现最强性能(EER:18.22%,TDR:52.00%),表明结构化推理即使没有任务特定训练也能有效捕捉出身份相关提示. DINOv2还展示了竞争表现(TMR:40.00%,38.00%),表明自控的表示保留了对细纹结构形态的敏感性. 相比之下,CLIP的表现相对薄弱,可能是由于它强调语义相接而不是精细的纹理上的歧视.
在合成数据上,大多数零镜头模型在域位移下会降解,而边缘-Forehead保持强性能(EER:0.25%;TDR:94.00%). GPT-4o在零射出型号(ER:25.44%)中表现最好,但与合成变异相搏. 总体而言,特异性特异性学习提高了核查的准确性和稳健性,而零射出型则提供了可解释性.

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 定性分析

blocks.en:
Table 2 presents a three-round response analysis to evaluate the consistency and reliability of FIRE-based verification. Several key behavioural patterns can be observed:
(i) Progressive Refinement , where predictions often improve across rounds; (ii) High-Confidence Stability , where clear samples yield consistent decisions; (iii) Recovery from Refusal , where initial refusals may be resolved through subsequent prompting; and (iv) Response Variability , where challenging cases can produce conflicting predictions due to model sensitivity and stochasticity. Additional prompt-ablation and stability analyses are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
表2提供了三轮响应分析,以评估基于FIRE的核查的一致性和可靠性。 可以观察到若干关键的行为模式:
(一) 逐步完善,预测往往在各轮之间有所改进;(二) 高度稳定性,其中明确的样本产生一致的决定;(三) 从拒绝中恢复,其中最初的拒绝可通过随后的催促解决;和(四) 反应可变性,其中具有挑战性的案件由于模型敏感性和花样性而产生相互矛盾的预测。 补充材料中提供了额外的即时抽取和稳定性分析。

blocks.en: Table 2: Round-wise response comparison across three inference passes. CLS: classification; Conf: confidence; Dis: dissimilarity; M: match; NM: non-match.
blocks.zh: 表2:经过三次推断的圆形答复比较。 CLS:分类; Conf:自信; Dis:异同; M:相配; NM:非相配.

blocks.en: Explainability Analysis
blocks.zh: 解释性分析

blocks.en:
make it crisp but keep important information
A key advantage of FIRE framework is its ability to provide human-interpretable explanations alongside verification decisions. Representative examples of genuine and impostor pairs are presented in the supplementary material with model-generated reasoning. For impostor pairs, FIRE correctly identifies differences in crease alignment and spacing despite illumination and resolution variations, achieving up to 85% confidence. For genuine pairs, it recognizes consistent crease patterns, producing high-confidence matches (95%) with low dissimilarity. These results demonstrate that FIRE enhances interpretability while generally aligning with human reasoning, although occasional errors remain under challenging visual conditions.
blocks.zh:
让它简单,但保存重要信息
FIRE框架的一个主要优点是,它有能力在作出核查决定的同时提供人的解释。 具有代表性的真假配对实例在补充材料中以模型生成的推理来呈现. 对于冒牌对子,FIRE正确识别出尽管有发光和分辨率变化的折叠对接和间隔的差异,实现高达85%的置信度. 对于真对来说,它识别出一致的折叠模式,产生高自信相配(95%)并低同分. 这些结果表明,FIRE可以增强可解释性,同时一般符合人的推理,尽管偶尔在挑战性的视觉条件下仍会出错.

blocks.en: 5.2 Domain-Adaptive & Trait specific Forehead-Crease Verification
blocks.zh: 5.2 特定领域和拖车前排-堆积物验证

blocks.en: Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 量化结果

blocks.en: Table 3 reports open-set verification performance for domain-adaptive models trained on FH-V1 and evaluated on FH-V2. The results reveal consistent trends across backbone architectures and margin-based loss functions.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了接受FH-V1培训并接受FH-V2评价的域适应模型的开放设置核查性能。 结果显示,各骨干架构和以差值为基础的损失职能的趋势一致。

blocks.en: Table 3: Open-set verification performance of foundation, domain-adaptive, face-recognition, and trait-specific models on FH-V2 after fine-tuning on FH-V1.
blocks.zh: 表3:在FH-V1上微调后,FH-V2上的地基,域适应性,面相识别和特异性特异性等的开位验证性能.

blocks.en:
For the FaceNet backbone, margin-based supervision significantly improves performance compared to standard formulations. ElasticFace achieves the best results (EER: 11.17%), benefiting from stochastic margin sampling that improves generalisation under limited identity evidence.
MobileFaceNet-V2 demonstrates the strongest overall performance across all architectures. In particular, MobileFaceNet-V2 combined with CosFace achieves the lowest EER of 9.31% and the highest TMR values. This can be attributed to its lightweight convolutional design, which effectively captures local texture patterns critical for forehead-based recognition.
SwinFace exhibits comparatively lower performance, with AdaFace achieving the best results within this group (EER: 13.44%). The reduced performance suggests that global attention mechanisms may be less effective for modelling highly localised crease structures.
For EdgeFace-Xs, MagFace achieves the best performance (EER: 11.01%), highlighting the importance of quality-aware feature learning in handling variations in image quality and crease visibility.
These findings indicate that both backbone architecture and margin-based supervision play a crucial role in capturing fine-grained biometric features.
blocks.zh:
就FaceNet主干而言,比起标准配方,以差值为基础的监督显著改进了业绩。 弹性法能取得最佳效果(EER:11.17%),受益于在有限身份证据下提高通缩性的有分色比分抽样.
移动 脸 Net-V2显示所有建筑的整体表现最强. 特别是"移动FaceNet-V2"与"CosFace"结合,实现了9.31%的最低EER和最高的TDR值. 这可以归结于它的轻量级分解设计,它有效地捕捉出对额头识别至关重要的局部纹理图案.
SwinFace的表现相对较低,AdaFace在这一组中取得了最佳成绩(ER:13.44%). 绩效的下降表明,全球关注机制对于建立高度本地化的折叠结构可能不太有效。
对于EdgeFace-Xs来说,MagFace实现最佳性能(EER:11.01%),突出了质量意识特征学习在处理图像质量和折叠能见度变化方面的重要性.
这些调查结果表明,骨干架构和以差值为基础的监督在捕捉精细生物鉴别特征方面发挥关键作用。

blocks.en: Figure 2: DET curves for forehead-crease verification on the open-set FH-V2 dataset.
blocks.zh: 图2:开口的FH-V2数据集上用于前额-折叠验证的DET曲线.

blocks.en:
Trait-Specific Forehead-Crease Verification : Table 3 compares Edge-Forehead with existing forehead-recognition approaches. Edge-Forehead achieves the lowest EER (8.30%) and competitive TMRs, surpassing Vision Foundation Models (DINOv2, CLIP). The results demonstrate that explicit modeling of fine-grained crease structures yields superior discriminability and robustness, underscoring the effectiveness of trait-specific learning for forehead-crease verification. EdgeFace-Base is fine-tuned on FH-V1, while EdgeFace-Base (inference) uses the original pretrained model without fine-tuning.
Figure 2 shows the DET curves for all models. EdgeForehead achieves the best overall trade-off, attaining the lowest EER (8.30%), while MFN-V2+CosFace delivers the strongest low-FMR performance. SwinFace variants exhibit higher FNMRs, suggesting weaker modeling of fine-grained crease patterns. These results highlight the effectiveness of locality-preserving architectures and trait-specific learning for robust forehead-crease verification.
blocks.zh:
轨迹-特定前额-创造物核查:表3比较了边额-前额与现有额识别方法. Edge-Forehead取得了最低的ER(8.30%)和有竞争力的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国,超过了Vision Foundation Models(DINOv2,CLIP). 结果显示,对精细折痕结构进行明确的模型化可产生优越的区别性和强性,这突出说明了对额外折痕进行核查的特异性学习的有效性。 EdgeFace-Base在FH-V1上被微调出,而EdgeFace-Base(推断出)则使用未经微调的原始预训模型.
图2显示所有模型的DET曲线. EdgeForehead取得了最佳的总体取舍,达到了最低的EER(8.30%),而最惠国-V2+CosFace则提供了最强的低FMR性能. SwinFace变种表现出较高的FNMR,暗示了细纹折痕模式的模型化较弱. 这些成果突出表明了地方保护架构和针对特定特征的学习的有效性,以进行有力的额外-额外核查。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work presents a systematic comparison of MLLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini), domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific models for forehead-crease biometric verification. While MLLMs enable interpretable zero-shot verification, their performance remains below specialized biometric systems. Domain-adaptive and trait-specific models consistently achieve lower EER and higher TMR, highlighting the importance of discriminative biometric learning. These findings indicate that FMs offer interpretable verification and valuable zero-shot capabilities, but security-critical biometric applications still require trait-specific learning for reliable deployment.
blocks.zh: 这项工作对MLLMs(GPT-4o,克洛德,双子座),域-适应学习,以及前额-克勒斯生物测定的特异性模型进行了系统比较. 虽然MLLMs能够进行可解释的零发核查,但其性能仍然低于专门的生物鉴别系统。 适应领域和特性的特异性模型始终达到较低的ER和较高的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国,突出了歧视性生物鉴别学的重要性。 这些调查结果表明,调频能提供可解释的核查和宝贵的零射能力,但安全关键生物鉴别应用仍需要针对具体情况的学习才能可靠地部署。
